title: Keep the rare-branch weight and reservoir-output qualification
statement: An initially logical-independent static bath bit triggers an onsite-product logical Pauli pulse with A=N² and p=eta²/N⁴. Per-site mean-square strength is eta², yet at fixed positive time the ideal-decoded full-diamond error is at least(2-o(1))eta²/N⁴. The unpulsed nominal branch stays exact and the pulse comparison costs O(p N/A), plus the nominal exponential error. Thus mean strength alone cannot replace a peak joint-norm/tail condition; arbitrary coherent reset-reservoir outputs are outside the stated reduced-generator comparison.
